**Coaching Note:**
Your knight on b5 was perfectly placed to strike. When Black advanced with d5, leaving the d4 pawn undefended, you had a forced win: **Nc7+** checks the king and attacks the undefended a8 rook simultaneously—that's a fork! Black must recapture with the queen (Qxc7) to save the rook, but then you reclaim material with Nxd4, winning the pawn. Always scan loose pieces and look for forcing checks that create multiple threats.
